Looking at this question, I need to identify the specific temperature at which muscle tissues were polymerised in this PNAS paper about CISD3/MiNT and skeletal muscle.

In standard histological protocols for muscle tissue processing, when tissues are "polymerised" (embedded in paraffin or similar medium), the polymerisation/solidification step is typically carried out at room temperature. While paraffin is melted at ~60°C for infiltration and pouring, the actual polymerisation (solidification) of the tissue block occurs at room temperature.

Based on standard histological methodology as described in papers of this nature, the muscle tissues would have been polymerised at room temperature.
